change_1turn_to_4turn.note: log(cost ratio) = log(price factor on identical anchor tokens) + log(volume/mix factor); shares split the 1-turn -> 4-turn change in the plain-sonnet/plain-opus geomean

same_cell_length_contrast.note: 1-turn (S1) and 4-turn (s1m) are different task suites; Haiku-routed cells appear only in the 1-turn pool

first_request_warmth.method: cold: each session's first request has its cache reads re-priced as writes; warm: the warmable prefix (median first-request cache read among warm sessions of the same campaign, cell and model) is re-priced from write to read where it was written; applied to both arms

rebuild_by_stratum.note: several routed cells share one anchor run, so pooled anchor cost double-counts

corrections.cost_source: cost_usd is the provider adapter's price-table estimate per response (it fits list prices exactly); it is not billing

definitions.uncached: input_tokens - cache_read_tokens (provider input_tokens includes reads, excludes writes; verified by price fit)
definitions.main_loop: llm:request with a system prompt and tools; background calls (e.g. session naming) excluded from switch counts, included in cost
definitions.model_switch: main-loop request whose model differs from the previous main-loop request
definitions.rebuild_excess_write: max(0, cache_write_i - max(0, prompt_i - prompt_{i-1})): writes beyond the new conversation tail
definitions.rebuild_usd: rebuild_excess_write x (write price - read price) of the new model: extra paid vs a warm read
definitions.config_switch: same model, thinking/effort changed (Anthropic also invalidates the message cache)
definitions.cost: sum of provider-reported cost_usd over all llm:response in the session (estimate, not billing)
definitions.time_ratio: result.json exec_time_ms (first request to last response), treat/anchor
definitions.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap, resampling tasks (clusters) with replacement

invocation.note: read-only: local result.json files and Amplifier session logs; no model calls
